process: Onshore LNG trains of 0.5 Mt/yr or more (GEM GGIT LNG October 2026)
value: Onshore LNG trains of 0.5 Mt/yr or more: liquefaction capacity per train of operating export terminals; Canadian facilities where three or more report a value, else North America or global (the scope is in each value's formula).

process: Onshore LNG trains of 0.5 Mt/yr or more (GEM GGIT LNG October 2026)
formula: median (p25-p75) of 27 operating onshore export units (capacity per train), North America (Canada, US, Mexico)
reference: GEM Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker, LNG Terminals, October 2026, 'LNG Terminals' tab: CapacityinMtpa / trains named in UnitName; FacilityType export, Status operating
note: Fewer than three Canadian facilities report it (Canada: 1: 7000 kt/yr), so the North America (Canada, US, Mexico) fleet. Per train: a unit printed as a range of trains (T1-T2, T1-T18) is divided by the number of trains; one median over units, so a modular terminal counts once per unit row. CAPACITY BASIS: product-output.
